answer: Think of a new identity as a boat tied to a jetty: it can float, but it cannot sail far until it proves itself. For its first ten epochs, everything it earns sits in escrow. Release needs three different clients to countersign finished work, and each epoch a random 5% of identities face a delta audit, where an independent reviewer re-measures the claimed output. A gap above 20% forfeits the escrow. A fake leaves a visible plume of unvouched work, so a thousand fakes means finding 3,000 client vouches and risking 60,000 POA of escrow at 60 per identity.
